# Lodha Altero Wakad Pune — Knowledge Base & AI Context File

> Project Overview: Lodha Altero is an ultra-luxury G+37 residential landmark developed by Lodha Group (Macrotech Developers Ltd) located on the 36-metre-wide Wakad-Bhosari BRTS road in Kaspate Wasti, Wakad, Pune, Maharashtra 411057.

## Key Facts & Specifications
- Developer: Lodha Group (Macrotech Developers Ltd)
- Project Name: Lodha Altero
- MahaRERA Registration: P52100079692 (maharera.maharashtra.gov.in)
- Location: Behind Croma Electronics, Datta Mandir Road, Kaspate Wasti, Wakad, Pune - 411057
- Land Parcel: ~2.7 Acres Freehold Land Parcel
- Towers & Elevation: 3 Towers | G+37 Storeys (120 meters tall)
- Possession Timeline: Phased deliveries starting December 2028 | Completion by June 2030
- Total Residences: Limited-density residences with 3-side open cross-ventilation

## Sanctioned Configurations, Carpet Area & Pricing
- 3 BHK Grande: 1,185 - 1,396 sq.ft. carpet area | Starting ₹2.09 Cr* onwards
- 3.5 BHK Royal Suite with Study: 1,450 sq.ft. carpet area | Starting ₹2.45 Cr* onwards
- 4 BHK Imperial Haven: 1,559 - 2,105 sq.ft. carpet area | Starting ₹3.15 Cr* onwards
- 5 BHK Bespoke Sky Duplex & Penthouse (Levels 35-37): 2,600 - 3,416 sq.ft. carpet area | Starting ₹5.25 Cr* onwards

## Crown Jewel Amenity: 25,000 Sq.Ft. Rooftop Sky Club
- Elevation: 37th Floor (120 meters above ground level)
- 50-meter temperature-regulated heated infinity sky pool overlooking Mula River & Sahyadri hills
- Computerized celestial stargazing observatory
- Professional tournament-grade Padel tennis court
- 400-meter cushioned rooftop jogging loop
- Sunset amphitheatre and al-fresco sky co-working lounge

## Connectivity & Location Multipliers
- Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park Hinjewadi Phase 1: 4.5 km (10 minutes)
- Phoenix Mall of the Millennium: 2.4 km (4-5 minutes)
- Mumbai-Bangalore Highway (NH-48): 1.2 km (2 minutes)
- Balewadi High Street & Baner: 6.5 km (12 minutes)
- Upcoming PMRDA Metro Line 3 (Wakad Station): 1.5 km (3 minutes)

## Complete Lodha Group Pune Residential Portfolio Ecosystem
1. **Lodha Altero (Wakad, West Pune)**
   - Typologies: 3, 3.5, 4 & 5 BHK Sky Residences & Penthouses (1,185 - 3,416 sq.ft.)
   - Starting Price: ₹2.09 Cr* Onwards
   - MahaRERA: P52100079692
   - Key Feature: 25,000 sq.ft. Rooftop Sky Club & 50m heated pool on 37th Floor; 4-5 mins to Phoenix Mall & Hinjewadi.
2. **Lodha Panache (Hinjewadi Phase 1, West Pune)**
   - Typologies: 2, 3 & 4 BHK Tech-Savvy Residences (745 - 1,420 sq.ft.)
   - Starting Price: ₹1.15 Cr* Onwards
   - MahaRERA: P52100050302
   - Key Feature: 20,000 sq.ft. clubhouse, co-working pods, walking distance to Wipro & Infosys circle.
3. **Lodha Giardino (Kharadi, East Pune)**
   - Typologies: 2, 3 & 4 BHK Botanical Residences (810 - 1,580 sq.ft.)
   - Starting Price: ₹1.35 Cr* Onwards
   - MahaRERA: P52100047585
   - Key Feature: Biophilic urban forest, Olympic-length pool, 5 mins from EON Free Zone & WTC.
4. **Lodha Bella Vita (NIBM Road, South Pune)**
   - Typologies: 2, 3, 4 & 5 BHK Mediterranean Enclave (790 - 2,150 sq.ft.)
   - Starting Price: ₹1.10 Cr* Onwards
   - MahaRERA: P52100046960
   - Key Feature: Reserved forest valley views, Italianate gardens, pristine air quality index.
5. **Lodha Belmondo (Gahunje, Mumbai-Pune Expressway)**
   - Typologies: 2, 3, 4 BHK & Luxury Golf Villas (880 - 4,500 sq.ft.)
   - Starting Price: ₹1.85 Cr* Onwards
   - MahaRERA: P52100000283
   - Key Feature: 100-acre riverside luxury enclave with 9-hole Greg Norman golf course & 50,000 sq.ft. clubhouse.
